title.narrative: LDSP PHASE II-UNDP-LBR-00122614

description.narrative: LDSP PHASE II The Decentralization Programme 2020-2024 presents the strategy, results framework and operational modalities for a five-year program of support to the decentralization of political, administrative, and fiscal governance in Liberia. The LDSP Phase II (2020-2024) is designed to support and facilitate the implementation of the National Policy on Decentralization and Local Government (NPDLG). It is also meant to operationalize the newly gazetted Local Government Act (2018). The LDSP II

Output Indicator

description.narrative: Consultant hired Jingles produced and aired on community radios in 15 counties

comment.narrative: - 4 regional Town Hall meetings - 40% improvement in levels of citizens awareness of key government services, at least 25% of mobile-registered citizens in pilot counties have either heard or used the CFM. - Conduct 2 TOTs on gender responsive participatory planning and budgeting - One (1) software installed @ CSCs - Ramps constructed at five CSCs. - Two bills enacted to support decentralization

- 20 Town Hall meetings held in 8 counties located in four (4) regions - Perception survey in process to determine actual results. - 2 TOTs on gender responsive participatory planning and budgeting conducted and 80 technicians trained. - Specialized equipment procure and software for Traditional Marriage Certificate installed. Deployment of equipment pending - Construction of Ramps ongoing at four (4) CSCs. - Revenue Sharing and Ministry of Local Government Bills finalized.

Produce jingles and aired in 15 counties
Hold at least 3 radio talk shows in Monrovia
LIBTALK platform launched
CFM pilot Counties assessed.

-Hire consultant/firm to develop & produce jingles in simple Liberian English & 16 vernaculars on the local government act (LGA); -Conduct radio appearance or talk-show once a month on 2 national radio stations based in Monrovia. -Air jingles on the 2 national radios . -Hire a contractor to refurbish 3 billboards with Decentralization messages in locations Capitol Hill, Congo Town Boulevard Junction & RIA. -Conduct Solar Needs Assessment in all 15 counties. -Maintain Internet facility in the 5 CFM pilot counties for four (4) months. -Maintain Solar panels and Battery back-up systems for CFM hubs in Grand Bassa and Sinoe counties. -Launch of LIBTALK Platform; conduct periodic field monitoring visits and support project management. -Conduct Target Setting Workshop for Cabinet MACS and Produce Performance Contract. -Engagement of stakeholders in 15 counties, and related Covid-19 hotspot areas, including Monrovia , focusing on CBOs, CSOs, community leaders, law- makers, Religious and traditional leaders, chiefs, county and local government officials, opinion leaders, youth and women groups). -Strengthen collaboration between key actors in the COVID-19 response, including County Health Teams, joint security, local government administrations, INGOs & NGOs. -Distribution of Information, Education and Communication (IEC)— including flyers, posters, megaphones—, and related IPC materials, including hand- washing materials, and face mask. -1 Complete Local Government Gender Policy, prepared by the Ministry of Internal Affairs under the Decentralization Programme Contract issued. -Conduct a rapid assessment to ascertain category of services that the CSCs can deliver in the context of COVID-19 Response. - Draft Revenue Sharing Formula Bill with provisions for equalization fund submitted to Legislature. -Recruit a consultant to draft a Local Government Ministry bill.

- 20 town hall meetings conducted in 7 counties. - 2 regional town hall meetings conducted with the Minister of Internal Affairs. - At least 60% of respondents who submit complaints through CFM system receive redress. - Addition 5 CFM hubs connected with internet. - 5 gender responsive budgeting training conducted in five regions. - 3 capacity building trainings conducted in financial management. - 1 business development training manual developed. - 1 business support service trainings provided to 100 entrepreneurs. - 14 local technicians trained to maintain the solar system setup. - 1 specialized training for MOT, MIA, & CNDRA staff. - 1 solar system setup in Montserrado. - 2 CSOs hired to advocate for the passage of the Revenue Sharing Bill.
